BIOS (M-mode, boot RAM)
crt0: stack, .bss, mtvec. Self-tests, SDRAM test. Mount the SD card (FAT32), read BOOT.TXT, copy each file to its SDRAM address.

div.div:
OpenSBI (M-mode)
Platform set-up from the device tree; sets medeleg / mideleg; MRET with MPP = S into the kernel. Stays resident to serve SBI calls (ECALL from S).

Linux 6.9 (S-mode)
Turns on Sv32 by writing satp; unpacks the initramfs; console on the UART.
